sloka: स शैलशिखराभेण तोरणेन समाहतः ।जगाम न क्षतिं वीरो वरदानात्स्वयम्भुवः ।। ७.१४.२८ ॥
transliteration: sa śailaśikharābheṇa toraṇena samāhataḥ ।jagāma na kṣatiṁ vīro varadānātsvayambhuvaḥ ।। 7.14.28 ॥

translations.english: Though struck by the archway resembling a mountain peak, the hero suffered no harm due to the boon granted by Svayambhu (Brahma).
